rationale: Standard Coptic numeral for 50 (Sahidic ⲧⲁⲓⲟⲩ). On this page used three times in arithmetical context: ⲡⲓⲧⲁⲓⲟⲩ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'the fifty men,' ϣⲁⲙⲧ ⲛ̄ϣⲉ ⲧⲁⲓⲟⲩ '350,' ⲙⲏⲧ ⲛ̄ϣⲉ ⲧⲁⲓⲟⲩ '1050.' Distinct from homograph ⲧⲁⲓⲟⲩ qualitative of ⲧⲁⲓⲟ 'honor.' The arithmetic 50 × 3 × 7 = 1050 confirms the numerical reading.
Greek κυριακή 'Lord's Day' = Sunday. Standard Christian/Manichaean ecclesiastical term for the weekly fast-day. Three Sundays of fasting structure the kephalaion's arithmetic.

proposed_english: bestow as a gift / show favor
rationale: Greek χαρίζομαι 'give freely, bestow grace' as Coptic verb with ⲣ̄- prefix. Standard NT/early Christian register for divine favor-giving.

proposed_english: the appointed lot / the assigned portion
rationale: Standard Coptic ⲧⲱϣ 'limit, lot, decree, appointment.' In ecclesiastical context here: the assigned-portion of the disciple's church — his appointed assignment within the institutional structure.

proposed_english: make me alone unto myself / leave me to myself
rationale: Lycopolitan imperative ⲁⲁⲗⲧ (= ⲁⲣⲓⲧ 'do/make me') + ⲁⲣⲁⲓ̈ 'unto me' + ⲟⲩⲁⲉⲉⲧ 'alone.' The disciple petitions for solitary status, removed from collective ecclesiastical office.
Lycopolitan ⲧⲏⲧⲉ likely from ⲧⲏ 'totality, all' as substantivized 'the totality, the sum.' Fits the arithmetical reckoning of 1050 angels as ⲧⲏⲧⲉ ⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ 'the sum of the angels.'
Compound: ⲣ̄- ('do') + ⲡϩⲙⲁⲧ (Lyc. = ϩⲙⲟⲧ 'grace, favor, gift'). Standard Coptic for granting a favor — here the disciple's request for the favor of release from office.
